findings.evidence: On the bench lay the approach to the point, as familiar to her as her own hand
findings.diagnosis: Simile tells familiarity instead of rendering it; 'familiar as her own hand' is stock residue. Cut the simile; let the reef-ink and her reading of it carry recognition.

findings.evidence: Mara looked at it for a long moment.
findings.diagnosis: 'for a long moment' is filler and redundant beside the following silence-beat.

findings.evidence: six sentences open with 'He' (He had / He walked / He set / He turned / He picked / He looked)
findings.diagnosis: Pronoun-subject opening density; the profile wants varied sentence openings. Recast one or two.

findings.evidence: moved between the two until the gap stood open between them
findings.diagnosis: 'between' twice in one clause; one instance suffices.
